note: Custer County's zoning map is published only as a PDF (4a.-Info-CusterZoning.pdf). The county Map Server (maps.terragis.net/custer) has parcels, ownership, cities, roads and flood layers but no zoning layer, and no ArcGIS REST zoning service turned up in searches. Challis, Clayton, Lost River, Mackay and Stanley have no queryable zoning GIS found either; zoningpoint.com lists them without endpoints.
